open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open Continuation20261114
/-- The literal existing finite dependency cache, with the original pair-node
fuel measure, ordered two children and newly calibrated enumeration combine. -/
def graph (n : Nat) : Program 3 := ExchangeGraphRecursion.graph
  OriginalEnumerationRecursionInterface.R OriginalEnumerationRecursionInterface.D (OriginalEnumerationRecursionInterface.G n)
/-- Existing own-root final cache extraction at actual R(seed)+1. No changed
rank, table encoding, rectangular course-of-values evaluator or selected tuple. -/
def enumeration (n : Nat) : Program 2 := ExchangeSelectedRecursor.exchange
  OriginalEnumerationRecursionInterface.R OriginalEnumerationRecursionInterface.D (OriginalEnumerationRecursionInterface.G n)
/-- Transparent numeric comparator only, not a replacement executable AST.
The parameter is the original nested pair; arbitrary numeric fields retain the
literal layer behavior, including malformed encoded heads and list entries. -/
def numericLayer (n variableBound param prior opened : Nat) : Nat :=
  evaluate (OriginalEnumerationConstructorLayer.layer n) (List.Vector.ofFn ![
    (Nat.unpair param).1,
    (Nat.unpair (Nat.unpair param).2).1,
    (Nat.unpair (Nat.unpair (Nat.unpair param).2).2).1,
    (Nat.unpair (Nat.unpair (Nat.unpair param).2).2).2,
    variableBound,prior,opened])
/-- All-raw comparator with exact original depth convention. At successor the
prior and opened calls both use predecessor fuel, with opened bound+1. -/
def numeric (n : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0,_,_ => 0
  | fuel+1,variableBound,param => numericLayer n variableBound param
      (numeric n fuel variableBound param) (numeric n fuel (variableBound+1) param)
end LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.SourceComputabilityCompletion.Continuation20261115.OriginalEnumerationRecursion

bound,prior,opened]. The original head codec is NOT the raw head-number codec. -/
def tagPayload (tag : Nat) : Program 1 := InternalApplicationCertificateConstructors.pairOf
  (OriginalRawSyntaxTransport.constant 1 tag) (.projection 0)
def variableBranch : Program 7 := .composition (InternalListMap.map OriginalRawSyntaxTransport.variableConstructor)
  (fun _ : Fin 1 => .composition OriginalAscendingRange.range ![.projection 4])
def lambdaPairs : Program 7 := .composition NumericDependencyCross.cross ![.projection 0,.projection 6]
def lambdas : Program 7 := .composition (InternalListMap.map (tagPayload 1)) (fun _ : Fin 1 => lambdaPairs)
def childPairs : Program 7 := .composition NumericDependencyCross.cross ![.projection 5,.projection 5]
def typedChildPairs : Program 7 := .composition NumericDependencyCross.cross ![.projection 0,childPairs]
def applications : Program 7 := .composition (InternalListMap.map (tagPayload 2)) (fun _ : Fin 1 => typedChildPairs)
def bottoms : Program 7 := .composition (InternalListMap.map OriginalRawSyntaxTransport.bottomConstructor) ![.projection 0]
def convertedHeads (n : Nat) : Program 7 :=
  .composition (OriginalEncodedNumberedEnumerationBranch.convertedHeads n) ![.projection 1]
def ordinaryPairs (n : Nat) : Program 7 := .composition NumericDependencyCross.cross ![convertedHeads n,.projection 5]
def ordinary (n : Nat) : Program 7 := .composition (InternalListMap.map (tagPayload 4)) (fun _ : Fin 1 => ordinaryPairs n)
def labelRange : Program 7 := .composition OriginalAscendingRange.range
  ![.composition .succ ![.projection 2]]
def typeTuples : Program 7 := .composition OriginalTypeListsEnumeration.enumeration ![.projection 3,.projection 0]
def numbered (n : Nat) : Program 7 := .composition (OriginalEncodedNumberedEnumerationBranch.branch n)
  ![labelRange,.projection 1,.projection 0,.projection 5,typeTuples,.projection 5]
def nils : Program 7 := .composition InternalListCodec.consCode
  ![.composition OriginalRawSyntaxTransport.nilConstructor Fin.elim0,InternalAcceptance.constantZero 7]
def argumentCons : Program 7 := .composition (InternalListMap.map (tagPayload 7)) (fun _ : Fin 1 => typedChildPairs)

product order retained. Each numeric slot is the corresponding original block. -/

  ![variableBranch,lambdas,applications,bottoms,ordinary n,numbered n,nils,argumentCons]
def join (a b : Program 7) : Program 7 := .composition InternalApplicationValidityStackAppend.append ![a,b]
/-- Literal left-associated source append order, not sorting or deduplication. -/
def layer (n : Nat) : Program 7 :=
  join (join (join (join (join (join (join variableBranch lambdas) applications) bottoms)
    (ordinary n)) (numbered n)) nils) argumentCons

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering.ID1Completion.SourceComputabilityCompletion.Continuation20261115.OriginalEncodedHeadConversion
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open InternalApplicationCertificateConstructors
open OriginalRawSyntaxTransport (constant succOf sameOf)
/-- State pair(quotient,remainder) for binary sum encoding; start pair(0,0)=0.
At each successor, toggle remainder, increment quotient only at remainder1. -/
def splitStep : Program 2 := InternalAcceptance.branch (rightOf (.projection 1))
  (pairOf (leftOf (.projection 1)) (constant 2 1))
  (pairOf (succOf (leftOf (.projection 1))) (constant 2 0))
def split : Program 1 := .recursion (constant 0 0) splitStep
def half : Program 1 := .composition InternalUnpair.left (fun _ : Fin 1 => split)
